attacks.name: Warrior Born
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push the defender |!range_small|.
|!critical| |!wild| |*Follow-Up|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small| Toward the defender.

attacks.name: Warrior Forged
steps: |!critical| |!hit| |*Mighty Bash|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character Throws the defender |!range_medium|. Then this character Advances |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Master Swordswoman
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| attack or targets a character with a |!physical| attack, it may use this superpower. If the enemy character is within |!range| 2, this character may reroll any number of its attack or defense dice.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Battle-Tested
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1 to a minimum of 1.
